triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER capture_founding_driver_delivery_zone_completion AFTER UPDATE OF entrance_lat, entrance_lng ON public.mfi_stops FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((NOT (old.lat IS DISTINCT FROM new.lat)) AND (NOT (old.lng IS DISTINCT FROM new.lng)))) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.capture_founding_driver_delivery_zone_completion()
